title: Surreal Tea Party in Forest
description: A skeletal figure in a yellow suit and ornate blue helmet floats while sipping tea from a cup, pointing toward a glowing purple portal in a large twisted tree that contains a white lotus flower, skulls, and a small skeleton. A small purple table with spilled blue liquid, an overturned teacup, and a coiled orange object sits below, surrounded by floating question mark bubbles, pink flames, and beams of light in an enchanted dark forest.
prompt: A skeletal figure wearing a bright yellow suit, blue gloves, and an ornate blue helmet with a pink skeletal face floats in mid-air while sipping from a teacup and pointing at a glowing purple oval portal embedded in a massive twisted tree trunk. Inside the portal is a luminous white lotus flower, skulls, and a tiny skeleton. A small purple table below holds a coiled orange pastry and an overturned cup spilling blue liquid. The dark enchanted forest background features gnarled trees, floating transparent bubbles with question marks, pink flames on the ground, and dramatic light beams filtering through the canopy.
